mapper.select: SELECT patient.id, patient.user_id, COALESCE(patient.real_name, account.name, account.username) AS name, account.username, account.phone, patient.status FROM patient INNER JOIN sys_user account ON account.id = patient.user_id WHERE patient.user_id = #{userId} AND patient.status = 1 AND account.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT patient.id FROM patient INNER JOIN sys_user account ON account.id = patient.user_id WHERE patient.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR account.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR account.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR account.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY patient.id
